task.name: Wash_communal_kitchenware
task.when: Once per shift and after communal kitchenware is used

step.action: Scrape food from 🍳 Kitchenware into 🍳 Wet_Trash_Bin.
Arrange 🍳 Three_Wash_Basins in wash, rinse, and sanitize order.
Fill the wash basin with enough potable water from 🔧 Fresh_Water_Tank to submerge the largest item.
Add 🍳 Dish_Soap to the wash basin according to its label.
Fill the rinse basin with enough potable water to submerge the largest item.
Fill the sanitize basin with enough potable water to submerge the largest item.
Add 🍳 Sanitizer_Tablets to the sanitize basin according to their label.
Use 🍳 Sanitizer_Test_Strips to verify the sanitize basin is between 200 and 400 ppm.
step.ifThen: IF the result is outside 200 to 400 ppm, THEN adjust the solution according to the sanitizer label and test it again.

step.action: Wash each item in the wash basin until no food or grease remains.
Rinse each washed item in the rinse basin.
Submerge each rinsed item in the sanitize basin for the label contact time.
Place each sanitized item on 🍳 Drying_Rack to air-dry.
Empty all three basins into 🔧 Gray-Water_IBC.
Put dry kitchenware in its storage place.

passWhen.criterion: All communal kitchenware is clean, sanitized, dry, and stored.
All dishwashing water is contained in the gray-water system.
The wash basins and drying rack are ready for the next person.

reasoning.entry: Use only enough basin water to submerge the largest item because potable water and gray-water capacity are limited.
Use a measured sanitizer concentration instead of guessing from tablet count.
